## Modules

## Mix Tasks

- [mix firmware.gen.script](https://ssh-subsystem-fwup.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Gen.Script.md): Creates a shell script for invoking ssh to upgrade devices with ssh_subsystem_fwup.
- [mix upload](https://ssh-subsystem-fwup.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Upload.md): Upgrade the firmware on a Nerves device using SSH.
